findings.defect: The censored username abbreviates Tang Sadok’s name; it does not mean “Party Involved.” The current rendering obscures the speaker’s identity and the joke.
findings.rationale: 당사* follows the same partially censored name pattern as 적천* and 청* and refers to Tang Sadok, Mimi’s original owner.

findings.current:
“Fine, I understand, you red-faced bastard.”

“What did you say? Why, you filthy bastard…”
findings.defect: “Red-faced” invents a physical description absent from the insult, while “filthy bastard” substantially softens the answering 개호로 잡놈. This weakens the profane escalation that makes the exchange absurd.
findings.rationale: 시뻘놈 is a vulgar deformation of a strong insult, not a reference to facial color, and 개호로 잡놈 is markedly stronger than “filthy bastard.”
findings.replacement:
“Fine. Got it, you fucker.”

“What was that? You goddamn son of a bitch…”
findings.source:
“그래, 알았다. 이 시뻘놈아.”

“뭐라? 이런 개호로 잡놈을 봤나…….”

findings.current: “Tony Tony Chopper—no, Mungyeong. Become my companion!”
findings.defect: The draft completes “Chopper,” but the source cuts Taekyung off at 쵸 before he corrects himself. Completing the name changes the timing of the self-interruption joke.
findings.rationale: The comma immediately after 쵸 marks an intentionally aborted name rather than the complete Chopper reference.
findings.replacement: “Tony Tony Cho—no, Mungyeong. Become my companion!”
findings.source: “토니토니 쵸, 아니 문경. 내 동료가 돼라!”

findings.current: I asked Hyuk Mujin, who had his eyes opened wide in astonishment.
findings.defect: “Had his eyes opened wide” is an unnatural passive construction and can imply that someone else opened his eyes.
findings.rationale: 눈을 동그랗게 뜬 describes Hyuk Mujin widening his own eyes in surprise.
findings.replacement: I asked Hyuk Mujin, whose eyes were wide with surprise.
findings.source: 나는 눈을 동그랗게 뜬 혁무진에게 물었다.

findings.current: Mungyeong watched him with a deeply sunken gaze.
findings.defect: “A deeply sunken gaze” is not natural English and suggests physically sunken eyes rather than Mungyeong’s subdued, weighty expression.
findings.rationale: 깊게 가라앉은 describes the settled, subdued quality of his gaze, not the physical position of his eyes.
findings.replacement: Mungyeong regarded him with a deep, somber gaze.

summary: One mistranslated censored username, altered profanity, and several localized fidelity or natural-English issues.
